description_target.target_text: Build a small lookup table from the example rows: local source-key motif to local target-value motif. Then match the query key motif and replay the corresponding value motif in the background query target.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Corner triads define local coordinate FRAMES: a 2 with orthogonal
 ;; 3/4 neighbors is a SOURCE frame, a 5 with 6/7 a TARGET frame. Each
 ;; source frame carries a motif of 8s in its local coordinates; the
 ;; first two source/target pairs teach motif -> decoration (8s and
 ;; 9s), and the third target gets the decoration its motif maps to,
 ;; painted through its own frame.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (uv< a b)
       (if (= (first a) (first b))
           (< (second a) (second b))
           (< (first a) (first b))))
     (define (point< a b)
       (cond ((not (= (first a) (first b))) (< (first a) (first b)))
             ((not (= (second a) (second b))) (< (second a) (second b)))
             (else (< (third a) (third b)))))
     ;; frame = (origin vx vy): local (u v) -> origin + u*vx + v*vy
     (define (gpos f u v)
       (list (+ (first (first f)) (* u (first (second f)))
                (* v (first (third f))))
             (+ (second (first f)) (* u (second (second f)))
                (* v (second (third f))))))
     (define (lpos f p)
       (let ((dr (- (first p) (first (first f))))
             (dc (- (second p) (second (first f)))))
         (list (+ (* dr (first (second f))) (* dc (second (second f))))
               (+ (* dr (first (third f))) (* dc (second (third f)))))))
     (define (frame< a b)
       (let loop ((xs (append (first a) (second a) (third a)))
                  (ys (append (first b) (second b) (third b))))
         (cond ((null? xs) #f)
               ((< (first xs) (first ys)) #t)
               ((> (first xs) (first ys)) #f)
               (else (loop (rest xs) (rest ys))))))
     (define (find-frames a b c)
       (sort (remove-duplicates
              (filter (lambda (x) x)
                      (for*/list ((r (in-range h)) (col (in-range w))
                                  (dx (in-list cardinal-deltas))
                                  (dy (in-list cardinal-deltas)))
                        (and (= (at g r col) a)
                             (in-bounds? (+ r (first dx))
                                         (+ col (second dx)) h w)
                             (in-bounds? (+ r (first dy))
                                         (+ col (second dy)) h w)
                             (= (at g (+ r (first dx))
                                    (+ col (second dx)))
                                b)
                             (= (at g (+ r (first dy))
                                    (+ col (second dy)))
                                c)
                             (zero? (+ (* (first dx) (first dy))
                                       (* (second dx) (second dy))))
                             (list (list r col) dx dy)))))
             frame<))
     (define (local-points f colors)  ;; (u v color) within radius 3
       (sort (filter (lambda (x) x)
                     (for*/list ((r (in-range h)) (c (in-range w)))
                       (and (member? (at g r c) colors)
                            (let ((uv (lpos f (list r c))))
                              (and (<= (max (abs (first uv))
                                            (abs (second uv)))
                                       3)
                                   (list (first uv) (second uv)
                                         (at g r c)))))))
             point<))
     (define (motif f)  ;; the 8-cells' local footprint
       (sort (map (lambda (p) (list (first p) (second p)))
                  (local-points f (list 8)))
             uv<))
     (define sfs (find-frames 2 3 4))
     (define tfs (find-frames 5 6 7))
     (define mapping
       (list (list (motif (first sfs)) (local-points (first tfs)
                                                     (list 8 9)))
             (list (motif (second sfs)) (local-points (second tfs)
                                                      (list 8 9)))))
     (for/fold ((out g))
               ((p (in-list (second (find (lambda (e)
                                            (equal? (first e)
                                                    (motif (third sfs))))
                                          mapping)))))
       (let ((rc (gpos (third tfs) (first p) (second p))))
         (set-cell out (first rc) (second rc) (third p)))))))
